exact_use_paragraphs: [F1] **Model objects.** $\mathfrak h=\{f\in L^{2}(\mathbb R^{3};\mathbb C^{3}):k\cdot f(k)=0\ \text{a.e.}\}$ is a closed subspace, $\varepsilon(k)=\alpha|k|$ is continuous, $g_{j}\in\mathfrak h$ with $\operatorname{supp}g_{j}\subseteq\{0<\varepsilon\le\Lambda\}$ and $g_{j}/\sqrt\varepsilon\in\mathfrak h$, so $M\in\mathfrak h$ with $\operatorname{supp}M\subseteq\{0<\varepsilon\le\Lambda\}$ ([[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-transverse-continuum-free-fock-hamiltonian]], [[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-cutoff-dipole-relative-bound]]).

[F2] **Kernel.** For $t>0$ and $x\ne0$, $K_{t}(x)=\dfrac{4\sin^{2}(xt/(2\hbar))}{x^{2}t}$ and $K_{t}(0)=t/\hbar^{2}$; $K_{t}\ge0$ is even and $\int_{\mathbb R}K_{t}(x)\,dx=2\pi/\hbar$; for $J\in L^{1}(\lambda)$ continuous at $\Delta$, $\lim_{t\to\infty}\int_{\mathbb R}K_{t}(x)J(\Delta+x)\,dx=\frac{2\pi}{\hbar}J(\Delta)$ ([[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-golden-rule-coefficient-approximate-identity]] clauses (a),(b)).

[F3] **The push-forward measure.** $
u_{b}$ is a finite Borel measure with $
u_{b}(\mathbb R)=\|M\|_{\mathfrak h}^{2}>0$, $
u_{b}(\mathbb R\setminus(0,\Lambda])=0$, and $\int_{\mathbb R}f\,d
u_{b}=\int_{\mathbb R^{3}}f(\varepsilon(k))\|M(k)\|^{2}d^{3}k$ for every Borel $f\ge0$; for the vector $A_{b}$ of the statement, $\|A_{b}(\cdot,t)\|_{\mathfrak h}^{2}=\eta_{0}^{2}t\int K_{t}(E-\Delta)d
u_{b}(E)$ for $t>0$ and $A_{b}(\cdot,t)\in\mathfrak h$ ([[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-golden-rule-coefficient-approximate-identity]] clauses (i),(ii)).

[F4] **Null sets of the kernel.** The set $\{x\in\mathbb R:K_{t}(x)=0\}$ equals $\{0\}\cup\{2\pi\hbar n/t:n\in\mathbb Z\setminus\{0\}\}$, a countable hence Lebesgue-null subset of $\mathbb R$; in particular $K_{t}>0$ $\lambda$-almost everywhere and $K_{t}$ is bounded by $t/\hbar^{2}$ ([[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-golden-rule-coefficient-approximate-identity]] clause (a), [[prop-countable-subsets-of-rn-are-lebesgue-null]]).

Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice and the Axiom of Choice
([[def-countable-choice]], [[def-axiom-of-choice]]). Let $\alpha>0$, let
$\mathfrak h=\operatorname{ran}M_{\Pi}\subseteq L^{2}(\mathbb R^{3};\mathbb
C^{3})$ be the transverse space with $\varepsilon(k)=\alpha|k|$ of
[[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-transverse-continuum-free-fock-hamiltonian]],
let $\Lambda>0$, let $g_{1},\dots,g_{J}\in\mathfrak h$ ($J\ge1$) satisfy
$$\operatorname{supp}g_{j}\subseteq\{k:\ 0<\varepsilon(k)\le\Lambda\},\qquad \frac{g_{j}}{\sqrt\varepsilon}\in\mathfrak h ,$$
let $\eta_{0}\in\mathbb R$ and let $c_{1},\dots,c_{J}\in\mathbb C$ with
$$M:=\sum_{j=1}^{J}c_{j}g_{j}\in\mathfrak h,\qquad M\ne0 .$$
Fix $\Delta\in\mathbb R$ and define the finite Borel measure
$$\nu_{b}(B):=\int_{\mathbb R^{3}}\mathbf 1_{B}\bigl(\varepsilon(k)\bigr) \|M(k)\|_{\mathbb C^{3}}^{2}\,d^{3}k,\qquad K_{t}(x):=\frac{1}{\hbar^{2}t}\Bigl|\int_{0}^{t}e^{ixs/\hbar}\,ds\Bigr|^{2}\ \ (t>0),$$
and the vector-valued function
$$A_{b}(k,t):=-\frac{i\eta_{0}}{\hbar}M(k)\int_{0}^{t} e^{i(\varepsilon(k)-\Delta)s/\hbar}\,ds\qquad(t\ge0).$$

**(b) Finite-level matter factor.** Take the declared charged pair, the
relative-coordinate factor $L^{2}(\mathbb R^{3};\mathbb C)$, the coordinate
multipliers $Q_{j}$ and the dipole operator components $D_{j}=-q\,Q_{j}$ of
[[post-nrqm-approximations-static-finite-level-dipole-coupling]] clauses
(i)-(ii), with the Coulomb energy operator $H_{\kappa}$ of clause (iv) of that
postulate. Fix, as model data, a declared finite-dimensional subspace
$$W\subseteq D(H_{\kappa})\cap D(Q_{1})\cap D(Q_{2})\cap D(Q_{3}),\qquad \dim W=d<\infty,$$
with a declared orthonormal basis $(w_{1},\dots,w_{d})$ of $W$
([[def-orthonormal-family-complete-orthonormal-system-and-hilbert-basis]]),
and read $W$ as $\mathbb C^{d}$ in that basis. The model's **compressed matter
energy** is the Hermitian $d\times d$ matrix
$$H_{a}:=\Pi_{W}H_{\kappa}\big|_{W},$$
read in joules, where $\Pi_{W}$ is the orthogonal projection onto $W$
([[def-hilbert-orthogonal-projection]]); the model's **compressed dipole
matrices** are the Hermitian $d\times d$ matrices
$$D^{W}_{j}:=\Pi_{W}D_{j}\big|_{W}\qquad(j=1,2,3),$$
read in $\mathrm{C\,m}$; and the model's **levels** are the pairs $(E,v)$ with
$E\in\mathbb R$ (joules) an eigenvalue of $H_{a}$ and $v\in\mathbb C^{d}$ a
nonzero eigenvector for $E$. A **declared level pair** is an ordered pair
$(a,b)$ of orthonormal eigenvectors $v_{a},v_{b}$ of $H_{a}$; its **transition
energy** is $E_{a}-E_{b}$. The subspace, its basis and its dimension are model
data: they are not derived from the Coulomb model and they replace the
unbounded operators $H_{\kappa},D_{j}$ by their compressions throughout this
pair.

**(e) Normalised single-vertex photon-energy law and ideal detection.** For
$t>0$ and $M\ne0$ the model's **normalised single-vertex photon-energy law** is
the Borel probability measure on $\mathbb R$
$$P_{b,t}(B):=\frac{\int_{B}K_{t}(E-\Delta)\,d\nu_{b}(E)} {\int_{\mathbb R}K_{t}(E-\Delta)\,d\nu_{b}(E)},\qquad K_{t}(x):=\frac{1}{\hbar^{2}t}\Bigl|\int_{0}^{t}e^{ixs/\hbar}\,ds\Bigr|^{2},$$
whose denominator is finite and strictly positive by
[[lem-nrqm-light-matter-first-order-photon-energy-law]] clause (b). The model
reads it as follows: the **declared single-vertex one-photon preparation** is
the unit vector $v_{b}\otimes(A_{b}(\cdot,t)/\|A_{b}(\cdot,t)\|_{\mathfrak h})$
of $\mathbb C^{d}\otimes\mathfrak h\subseteq\mathbb C^{d}\otimes
F(\mathfrak h)$, and for a Borel window $B\subseteq[0,\infty)$ the declared
ideal energy-window detector of window $B$ of
[[def-nrqm-photons-framework-ideal-counting-and-detection-model]] clause (c)
has the Born probability $P_{b,t}(B)$ in that preparation, because the energy
law of a unit one-photon vector $f$ is the push-forward of
$\|f(k)\|_{\mathbb C^{3}}^{2}d^{3}k$ under $k\mapsto\varepsilon(k)$
([[def-nrqm-photons-framework-radiation-sector-and-quantum-assignments]] clause
(e)). A **detected photon energy** is therefore a spectral reading of the
assigned free-field energy observable $(H_{f},\mathrm J)$, not a sharp energy
of a normalisable state and not a quantum number of the model's mode labels.
